title: Learning interrupted
discussion_signal: The post explains how repeated floods, storms, and heatwaves interrupt learning while also removing meals, safety, and stability supplied by schools, with disproportionate effects on girls, disabled children, displaced children, and children in poverty. It presents resilient infrastructure, early warning, emergency planning, and learning continuity as system responses.
linked_research_question: How do climate shocks cascade through education, nutrition, safety, and inequality, and which systems preserve continuity?
limits: No school-level comparative outcomes are shown
The post does not quantify which resilience investments are most effective
